Metadata.description: Job search companion: track applications, get prepared, and act on the right opportunity in time.

Validation.samePassword: The new password must differ from the current one.
Validation.url: Enter a link that starts with http:// or https://.
Validation.wholeNumber: Enter a whole amount, without dots or commas.
Validation.currency: Use a 3-letter code, such as MXN or USD.
Validation.salaryIncomplete: A salary needs its currency and period.
Validation.salaryRange: The maximum cannot be lower than the minimum.
Validation.salaryTarget: Set the minimum salary, currency and period together, or leave all three empty.

SignIn.title: Sign in
SignIn.temporaryPasswordExpired: Your temporary password has expired. Ask the admin for a new one.

Setup.title: Set up Kairo
Setup.description: Create the admin account. This happens once; after that, the admin creates every other account.
Setup.alreadyDone: Kairo is already set up. Sign in.

Password.title: Change password
Password.description: Your other sessions will end; this one stays open.
Password.required: Your account uses a temporary password. Change it to continue.
Password.wrongCurrent: The current password is not correct.

Admin.title: Accounts
Admin.description: Create accounts and manage their access. You never see what each person keeps in Kairo here.

create.title: New account
create.description: Kairo generates a temporary password that expires in 72 hours.
create.emailTaken: An account with this email already exists.

temporaryPassword.title: Temporary password
temporaryPassword.description: Share it with {name}. It is shown only this once and expires in 72 hours.

makeAdmin.title: Make {name} an admin?
makeAdmin.description: They will be able to create and manage accounts.

makeUser.title: Remove {name}'s admin role?
makeUser.description: They will no longer manage accounts.

deactivate.title: Deactivate {name}?
deactivate.description: They will not be able to sign in, and all their sessions will end.

reactivate.title: Reactivate {name}?
reactivate.description: They will be able to sign in again.

resetPassword.title: Reset {name}'s password?
resetPassword.description: Their current password stops working, their sessions end, and they sign in with a new temporary one.

errors.lastAdmin: There must be at least one active admin.

Jobs.title: Jobs
Jobs.description: The jobs you are following, by stage.

placeholders.description: Paste the whole posting here: it stays even if the posting disappears.

duplicates.title: You saved {company} · {title}, but it looks like jobs you already have
duplicates.description: Check whether it is the same posting. The new job was saved anyway.

JobDetail.noDescription: You did not save this job's description.

delete.title: Delete {name}?
delete.description: The job and its whole history will be deleted. Its tasks stay, without a job. This cannot be undone.

tasks.title: Tasks
tasks.empty: No tasks for this job yet.

Criteria.title: Your criteria
Criteria.description: What you look for in a job. Every job shows whether it meets it. Only your account keeps it.

salary.title: Salary
salary.description: A job meets it when the top of its range reaches this minimum, in the same currency and period. Leave it empty to skip it.

contract.title: Contract type
contract.description: Tick the ones you accept. With none ticked, any contract works.

Today.title: Today
Today.greeting: Hi, {name}. Here's what's on your plate.

empty.title: Nothing pending
empty.description: Add a task, or set a follow-up on one of your jobs.

Tasks.jobNotFound: That job no longer exists. Pick another one.

postpone.label: Postpone the follow-up with {job}
postpone.title: Postpone the follow-up
postpone.notBeforeToday: Pick today or a later day.
